description: Searches the public coverage catalog by name or alias, with optional region and activity filters. Coverage follows the current public scope. Region filters include WA, OR, and BC. Results list each objective's slug and route IDs with their activities, which the other tools take as inputs. An optional area input limits results to the objectives the coverage directory lists under that area. Query and area can be combined, and at least one of them is needed. A query that names an area or a reviewed place name lists that area's objectives, marked by matchedBy, after any objectives matched by name. Informational only.

area.description: Optional public area slug from list_areas. Limits results to the objectives the coverage directory lists under that area. At least one of query and area is needed.

query.description: Objective name, alias, place name, or area name; matching ignores case and accents. At least one of query and area is needed.

region.description: Optional state or province code or name: WA, Washington, OR, Oregon, BC, British Columbia, or B.C. Matching ignores case.
